title: Secure Cover Selection for Steganography
motivation: 现有cover选择方法在individual-level不安全，可被pooled steganalysis识别
problem_framing: cover图像子集的统计特性与全体图像不同导致steganographer可被聚类检测
key_insight: 用MMD距离约束选择过程，保持stego集与clear集的距离不超过任意两clear集的距离阈值
method_signature: MMD约束下的最小失真图像搜索策略
evaluation_criteria: 图像级P_E(分类错误率)与individual级DA(检测准确率)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: method in [21] performs best in image level but loses all in individual level, trade-off exists
evidence_for_taste: spare no pains to increase image level without considering individual
the steganographer can be easily identified
the abnormality is evidence of guilt
thinking_moves: 从steganalysis检测结果反推统计特性异常
将individual-level security形式化为MMD距离约束
在约束条件下做贪心搜索优化图像级安全性
